issue.title: Retire completion_refresh_on_update
issue.description: After a successful sase update, regenerate, zcompile, and restamp installed shell completion scripts. Off by default while the generator soaks.

task_type_fields.remove_when: The generator has soaked through several `sase update` runs without producing a broken or stale completion script on any supported shell.
task_type_fields.when_disabled: `sase update` leaves installed completion scripts untouched; they refresh only on an explicit `sase completion install`.
task_type_fields.when_enabled: After a successful `sase update`, installed shell completion scripts are regenerated, zcompiled, and restamped.

payload.entry:
PROVENANCE: this bead replaces sase-om, the `flag`-issue-type bead that owned `completion_refresh_on_update` from its creation at 2026-08-17T15:41:43Z by bbugyi200.athena.sase-oc.7 until epic sase-pv phase sase-pv.7 (migrate) deleted it on 2026-08-18. Feature flags are no longer their own bead type, so the old bead could not be converted in place -- the bead store's append-only guard makes `issue_type` immutable after `issue_created` -- and it was removed with `sase bead rm` and re-created here through `create_flag_bead`, the path `sase flag new` uses.

CARRIED OVER UNCHANGED: title, size (small), kind (beta), and both removal thresholds (2026-11-15 / 0.18.0). No deadline moved as a side effect of the migration.

AUTHORED FOR THE NEW REQUIRED FIELDS: `when_enabled`, `when_disabled`, and `remove_when` were drafted in the epic plan and each was verified against the code before it was written here. `src/sase/feature_flags/registry.py` now points `completion_refresh_on_update` at sase-qg.

SOAK EVIDENCE for completion_refresh_on_update (sase-qg)

Recorded 2026-08-21T15:16:20Z by sase-ru.2. Flag definition unchanged (beta, default Off, bead sase-qg, remove_by 2026-11-15 / 0.18.0). Production gate in maybe_refresh_installed_completions remains.

Environment: sase 0.16.0; bash 5.2.37; fish 4.0.2; zsh 5.9. All scripts and stamps used disposable directories (tmp_path completions/ plus pytest-isolated SASE_HOME), never the operator home.

Method: handle_update_command (production sase update path) with a successful managed uv-tool upgrade, completion_refresh_on_update enabled, and the production stamped-install refresh (real emitters + real zcompile). Initial stamps were version 0.15.0; scripts were overwritten with a stale marker and zsh .zwc removed before the first cycle.

Results (pytest tests/completion/test_update_refresh_soak.py, 6 passed):
- Three successful update cycles on bash, fish, and zsh: stale bytes replaced; emitter headers contain "(sase 0.16.0)"; stamps restamped to 0.16.0 owner=local; zsh .zwc rewritten and fresh; cycles 2 and 3 identical to cycle 1 (idempotent). list_shell_statuses: installed / zwc fresh.
- Mixed installed/absent: bash+zsh refreshed; fish stayed not installed across two cycles.
- Per-shell failure isolation: bash, fish, and zsh each failed in turn (RuntimeError from that shell's installer). Update exit 0; failed shell kept the stale script; the other two still regenerated, restamped, and zcompiled.
- Chezmoi skip: fish stamp owner=chezmoi was reported skipped and left untouched (content and 0.15.0 stamp unchanged); unmanaged bash+zsh still refreshed.
- Refresh skips zsh ${_comps[sase]} probing (first-install only), so disposable-directory updates are attributable without false fpath failures. chezmoi skip still happens before install, so managed-file protection is unchanged.

Focused plus scoped verification: tests/completion/test_update_refresh_soak.py, tests/completion/test_install.py, tests/main/test_update_command_completion.py, and just test-scoped (1818 passed, 172 files). Flag registry/schema not edited.

Acceptance: multiple successful unmanaged cycles on all three supported shells, plus failure isolation and chezmoi skip. Ready for completion_retirement (sase-ru.7) to make the On path unconditional and close this flag bead.

Soak passed (sase-ru.2, 2026-08-21): unmanaged bash/fish/zsh refresh across 3 successful sase update cycles in disposable dirs (real emitters + zcompile), stale replacement, idempotence, mixed absent shells, per-shell failure isolation, chezmoi skip. Evidence file:explicit:247001ef31ee220528ea9398. Retirement (sase-ru.7): deleted Off early-return in maybe_refresh_installed_completions so post-success refresh is unconditional; retained report model, per-shell isolation, nonfatal fallback, stamps, zcompile, and chezmoi skips. Removed FeatureFlag.completion_refresh_on_update, registry/schema/docs/help, and Off-state tests (now dry-run and upgrade-failure eligibility). tools/sync_feature_flags_schema --write. Focused pytest 72 passed.
